inputs.ad_text_01: Black-and-white observational documentary footage for a serious economics explainer. Neutral grayscale silver-gelatin photography, detailed faces and material textures, soft daylight, moderate contrast, clear readable composition. Original illustrative reconstruction. Natural restrained gestures, physically coherent objects and hands. Landscape 16:9. One continuous shot, gentle camera movement only. No subtitles, no readable lettering, no logos, no watermark, no graphic overlays. Close overhead shot of a contemporary accountant's hands comparing a rental ledger, an ordinary paper calendar and a loan repayment schedule on a textured desk. She circles one calendar cell, checks it against the contract, then presses a calculator key. Papers have indistinct writing, the exact labels will be added in post-production.
